title: Director, Mobility Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.</p></div><p>As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank’s expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.</p> <p>You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank’s representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction.</p> <p>This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build Material Bank’s founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine.</li> <li>Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution.</li> <li>Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community.</li> <li>Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers.</li> <li>Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank’s strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business.</li> <li>Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders.</li> <li>A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach.</li> <li>Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders.</li> <li>Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows.</li> <li>Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America.</li> <li>A passion for innovation and the future of mobility design.</li> </ul> <div> <div class="job__description body"> <div> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers </strong>through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. Our powerful material database and proprietary robotic distribution facility allow members to order samples to be delivered free of charge overnight.Material Bank was founded by Adam Sandow in 2018 and has deeply transformed how the Architecture and Design industry works in the United States. It’s an exciting time for the company - <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart</strong>. Candidates who join us will have the unique opportunity to define, build, and shape our European business.</p> <p>Material Bank uses your information to process your current application and offer you job opportunities in the future. You have the right to access, rectify, and erase this information, as well as to limit its use or object to it and give directives on its fate after your death. For more information, please consult our privacy policy: <a href="https://www.materialbank.eu/privacy-policy">https://www.materialbank.eu/privacy-policy</a></p> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong><em>What you’ll get from us:</em></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Our people</em></strong><em>: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.</em></li> <li><strong><em>Relaxation and Celebrations</em></strong><em>: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). </em></li> <li><strong><em>Health Benefits</em></strong><em><strong>:</strong> We </em><em>contribute</em><em> to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term </em><em>disability plans </em><em>and have a strong employee assistance program. </em></li> <li><strong><em>Plan for your Retirement</em></strong><em><strong>:</strong> 401(k) </em><em>eligible</em><em> after your first 90 day's employed!</em></li> <li><strong><em>Giving Back</em></strong><em>: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities. </em></li> <li><strong><em>Growth</em></strong><em>: We’ll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters! </em></li> <li><strong><em>Flexible Work Schedules</em></strong><em>: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a <strong>hybrid working</strong> model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.  </em></li> </ul> <p>Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.</p> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish-Speaking - London, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our London office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>This role is based in London.</p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Coffee Chat with Sales Team - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits </strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits </li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance </li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office </li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided </li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. </p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <p>Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice <a href="https://pallet.com/privacy">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p> <p>Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. title: Senior Experiential Creative Lead - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Experiential (3D) Creative Lead with extensive creative industry experience.</p> <p>You’ll take a key role in the entire process of creating experiential projects from creative concepting through to production information, making sure our Studio’s creative excellence and client’s vision is brought to life accurately. You create engaging brand experiences that connect audiences to a client’s message, product, or service across physical and digital environments. This role blends creativity, storytelling, and execution leadership.</p> <p>Core to your role is shaping how people feel, move, and interact within a space. You begin by reviewing project briefs and aligning on brand objectives, audience goals, and spatial requirements to establish a strong conceptual foundation. From there, you develop and present design concepts to clients, clearly articulating the vision and incorporating feedback into thoughtful revisions.</p> <p>You coordinate closely with vendors and production partners to ensure designs are feasible and executed to specification, and you conduct site visits to oversee installation and resolve on-site challenges. Overall, your day-to-day work balances creative ideation, design development, technical problem-solving, and hands-on execution to bring immersive environments to life.</p> <p>You’ll build relationships across the wider agency and be capable of adapting to take on a variety of briefs that may require, for example, graphic or brand design expertise. Showing a willingness to ask questions which build a deep understanding of the task ahead.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>In Studio, we create ideas and bring them to life. We’re a multi-disciplined team, creating content for integrated marketing campaigns, brand experiences and brand identity. We currently have a team of around 35; a mix of Creatives, Brand and Digital Designers, Editors and Content Producers and Creative Project Managers, supplemented by freelancers when specialist skills are needed or workload dictates.</p> <p>Everyone that succeeds here enjoys the diversity of clients and projects and is driven to do great work that will have a positive effect on our clients’ businesses.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate creative ideas into impactful experiential activations and events. </li> <li>Partner with creative, strategy and client teams from project inception. </li> <li>Lead the design of exhibitions, trade shows, conferences and immersive brand experiences. </li> <li>Develop floor plans, spatial concepts and visualisations that bring ideas to life. </li> <li>Present and defend experiential concepts directly with clients and stakeholders. </li> <li>Ensure alignment between creative vision, production requirements and client objectives. </li> <li>Manage freelance specialists and external partners to deliver high-quality outputs. </li> <li>Provide hands-on creative leadership across global events, activations and healthcare conferences. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <div>Proven experience in experiential, exhibition, or environmental design, ideally delivering projects for consumer brands.</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong ability to develop and deliver creative concepts from initial ideation through to final execution, balancing innovation with brand guidelines.</div> </li> <li> <div>Expertise in creating concept sketches, 3D models, photorealistic renders, and technical design drawings to communicate and realise design ideas.</div> </li> <li> <div>Proficiency in 3D design and visualisation software (e.g. Vectorworks, Cinema4D, 3ds Max, SketchUp) and Adobe Creative Suite.</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including creative, digital, motion, AV, production, and communications specialists, to deliver integrated brand experiences.</div> </li> <li> <div>Sound understanding of materials, fabrication methods, production processes, and sustainable design principles, with a focus on modularity and reuse.</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong client-facing skills, with the ability to present ideas confidently, manage feedback, articulate design rationale, and build trusted relationships.</div> </li> <li> <div>Excellent project management and communication skills, capable of overseeing multiple projects, managing stakeholder expectations, identifying risks, and supporting new business pitches and proposals.</div> </li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Burson’s Intelligence & Insights capability builds the data infrastructure, pipelines and AI-enabled workflows that power communications measurement and impact reporting at scale. Reporting directly to JT Joseph within the Intelligence & Insights practice and based in London, UK (Hybrid working policy), this role is central to leading the technical development of Fount, Burson’s flagship communications intelligence platform.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for translating product vision and technical specifications into robust, scalable data engineering and business intelligence solutions. Working closely with product leadership, you will contribute technical insights and architectural recommendations that help shape the platform's future evolution. You will operate within a structured Agile team managed in Jira, where product vision, priorities and roadmaps are set by Product Owners, while your core focus is executing this vision to the highest engineering standards.</p> <p>You will serve as the lead engineer responsible for building, maintaining and enhancing Fount, Burson’s custom data pipeline and database layer for communications reporting. Fount enables analysts to configure client monitoring subscriptions, Boolean searches, data ingestion and AI enrichment through an analyst-facing configuration layer. Under the direction of product leadership, you will execute technical deliverables that make the platform more reliable, scalable and seamless for non-technical users to configure and operate.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role with technical leadership and mentoring responsibility, rather than a formal people-management position. title: Graduate - Scale Space
description: <h1>Graduate Programme — Scale Space</h1> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?</li> <li>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</li> <li>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a growing business operates, while being supported to take ownership of work that matters?</li> </ul> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>Scale Space</strong>, one of the businesses within the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.</p> <h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets. Ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees supporting their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We work closely with investment and strategic partners including PayPal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, Worldpay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to best-practice tools, solutions and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new businesses get off the ground, including technology, growth, talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <h2>IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and OnSide Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <h2>ABOUT SCALE SPACE</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Scale Space is a community and workspace designed to bring together ambitious businesses, entrepreneurs, scale-ups and innovators.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Based in White City, Scale Space provides more than just flexible workspace. It creates an environment where growing businesses can connect, collaborate and access the networks, expertise and opportunities they need to scale.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The team works across community, events, partnerships, operations and customer experience to ensure that members receive a high-quality experience while helping to build a connected and ambitious business community.</p> <h2>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>Scale Space</strong>.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will be embedded within the Scale Space team and contribute to meaningful projects across the business, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Dedicated to Scale Space</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Scale Space. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Scale Space and its growth, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.</li> <li><strong>Training & Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Scale Space. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Scale Space team.</li> <li><strong>Early Careers Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your substantive role remains fully dedicated to Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Graduate Community</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Accountability</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>– you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Scale Space and see the direct impact of your work on the business, its members and the wider community.</li> </ul> <h2>ARE YOU BC?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech-related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline. Different areas of expertise bring valuable new perspectives.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. description: <h2>About the Opportunity</h2> <p>We are looking for a People Director to help lead our Europe business through its next phase of growth. You will represent the needs of the Europe business globally while helping translate our global objectives into regional priorities. </p> <p>Success in this role requires someone who is highly visible in the business, builds credibility and relationships quickly, brings the the confidence and judgment to influence senior leaders, and can introduce the right level of structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. </p> <p>You will lead and develop our existing Europe People team and work closely with our Global People and Talent team. </p> <p>This is a hybrid role with a minimum of three days per week in the office, plus regular travel to Lisbon.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the People strategy across the UK and Portugal, aligned with Europe and global business objectives.</li> <li>Help lead Europe through its next stage of scale, anticipating the organisational, leadership and talent capabilities needed as the business grows.</li> <li>Connect Europe to the global business, translating global priorities into regional People priorities while representing Europe’s needs in global decisions.</li> <li>Build strong, trusted relationships across the business, becoming a credible adviser to leaders on both business and People decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen leadership and management capability, coaching leaders through performance, organisational challenges, change and difficult people decisions.</li> <li>Build and retain exceptional talent, particularly across our technical and consulting teams, through career development, performance, compensation, <li>Lead, mentor and develop the Europe People team, creating opportunities for the team to grow while maintaining ownership and autonomy.</li> <li>Build scalable People practices without Lead & Evolve the FBP Team: Coach, mentor, and elevate a well-performing team of Finance Business Partners, setting clear capability standards, and fostering a curious, data- and impact-driven culture. Proven Finance Business Partner excellence: Proven track record designing and implementing best-in-class FBP frameworks across SaaS/scale-up environments. SaaS & Subscription Economics Fluency: Deep fluency in recurring revenue drivers, growth/efficiency trade-offs, and core SaaS metrics (ARR, CAC/LTV, retention, payback, sales capacity, pipeline, and product margin economics). C-Suite Influence & Communication: Proven ability to partner with and challenge executive leadership, framing choices clearly and turning complex data into structured, actionable guidance. People Leadership & Capability Building: A track record of assessing, coaching, and developing an existing finance team, helping individuals elevate their strategic impact through organizational change. Strategic Planning & Commercial Judgment: High proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business case development in fast-paced, ambiguous scale-up environments. title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the Role MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in. We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend. You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you’ll have impact: Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability. Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components. Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies. Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there. Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty. What you’ll bring: 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript. Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals. Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS. Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty. Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices. Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear. An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief. Nice to have: Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up). Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering. Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers. Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. Office and commercial positions, from initial search through to offer.</li> <li>Headhunt candidates who might not be actively looking but could be excited by what we’re building.</li> <li>Source and candidate experience that feels unmistakably Myprotein.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills & Experience: </strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 12 months’ recruitment experience, gained in an agency or an title: Senior Platform/Dev Ops Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><div>We are seeking a Senior Platform Enablement / DevOps Engineer to lead the design, scalability, reliability, and evolution of our enterprise developer platform and cloud-native delivery ecosystem.</div> <div><br>This role combines deep technical expertise with platform strategy, operational leadership, and engineering enablement. You will help define standards, modernize deployment practices, improve developer experience, and drive platform reliability across multi-cloud environments.<br>The ideal candidate has strong experience building enterprise-scale CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes ecosystems, Infrastructure as Code, observability solutions, and developer enablement capabilities.</div> <div><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li>Architect, build, and evolve scalable platform engineering and DevOps solutions for enterprise engineering teams.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of modern CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD, GitHub, and related tooling.</li> <li>Drive platform standardization, automation, reliability, and self-service engineering capabilities.</li> <li>Design and manage scalable Infrastructure as Code frameworks using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.</li> <li>Lead Kubernetes platform architecture, Helm-based deployments, and container orchestration best practices.</li> <li>Establish observability standards and operational excellence using Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and related tooling.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering, security, cloud, and architecture teams to improve platform capabilities and developer workflows.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to platform engineering best practices, governance, and technical strategy.</li> <li>Lead incident response, reliability improvements, root cause analysis, and operational maturity initiatives.</li> <li>Improve platform security, scalability, resiliency, and deployment efficiency across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.</li> <li>Evaluate and introduce new technologies, tooling, and automation opportunities aligned with platform engineering goals.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Required Skills & Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering, or related roles.</li> <li>Strong expertise in designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD and cloud-native platforms.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with: <ul> <li>Jenkins</li> <li>Kargo / ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform / Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Kubernetes & Helm</li> <li>Docker</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong experience with multi-cloud infrastructure: <ul> <li>AWS, Azure, and/or GCP</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong understanding of observability ecosystems including: <ul> <li>Grafana</li> <li>Loki</li> <li>Prometheus</li> <li>OpenTelemetry tooling</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong scripting/programming experience with Python, Kotlin, Bash, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with build and dependency tooling such as Gradle, Poetry, and UV.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, distributed systems, and platform reliability engineering.</li> <li>Experience driving platform modernization and developer enablement initiatives.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP) at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Experience with platform governance, security, secrets management, and compliance integration.</li> <li>Exposure to event-driven platform architectures and scalable distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring teams and influencing engineering standards across organizations.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern platform engineering trends, GitOps practices, and cloud-native ecosystems.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Technologies You’ll Work With</strong></div> <ul> <li>Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform & Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, Helm</li> <li>AWS, Azure, GCP</li> <li>Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry</li> <li>Python, Kotlin, Gradle</li> <li>UV, Poetry</li> <li>Linux & Networking</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  </p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who are we? At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Why are we hiring for this role? Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high-performing team to onboard and enable our customers. The ideal candidate will be experienced in leading customer interactions, detail-oriented, articulate, and credible with the ability to listen effectively and provide clear advice. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll report to the Head of Customer Success, EMEA, and analyze the causes of your customer’s greatest pain points and work closely to mitigate them using UpGuard technology. You will solicit constant feedback from both customers and colleagues, helping improve UpGuard over time, and you’ll work with customers around the world, from early contact to successful deployment, gaining constant, and unique, insight into the world's most important industries and institutions. What will you accomplish? You will onboard and manage UpGuard customers to ensure they understand how best to use UpGuard effectively to meet their goals. You will provide resources to your customers, including success plans, and customer-specific training sessions. You will also organize regular check-in calls. You will engage your customers early and frequently, to help them get the most out of UpGuard from day one and continue to drive engagement. You will translate your customers’ requirements by understanding their risk management frameworks to offer a tailored solution on how best they can utilize UpGuard. You will monitor the health of your customers and intervene with proactive education when customers are not effectively using UpGuard to achieve the value they expected. Advocate for the customer; Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product, Sales, and Marketing) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities. What do we need from you? 5+ years' experience in customer success, and account management working with or for enterprise organizations. Self-starter with a proven track record of driving customer success and aligning complex customer solutions at the executive and department levels. Experience with supporting, building & maintaining customer relationships. Highly organized with the ability to update existing documentation and document new processes. Proven success in owning growth and revenue for a book of business including the end-to-end renewal process. An understanding of cyber risk management or risk management frameworks. Experience navigating large and complex organizations to multithread and uncover opportunities for expansion. High level of proficiency in the English language, both written and spoken. The ability to work cross-functionally with many internal groups and be a team player. Can translate complex ideas to a variety of audiences. Ability to work with multiple teams, stakeholders, and subsidiaries within an organization. High energy and a willingness to learn. Self-motivated, independent, and organized. What would give you an edge? Experience in Customer Success tools, such as ChurnZero or GainSight. Experience with a CRM, such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Understanding of technical cyber security compliance and certification activities such as NIST, PCI, and ISO27001. Understanding of Cyber Security best practices. Experience in project management. Basic/working knowledge of APIs. Experience navigating large enterprise relationships from implementation through value recognition and expansion. What’s in it for you? Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries. 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why! As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC. title: Senior Product Manager
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. About the Role Summary Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups. We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line. This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability. A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on. Success Metrics / KPIs Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window. Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter. Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release. Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release. Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding. What You'll Do Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy. Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write. Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release. Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release. Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet. Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content. Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization. Functional Competencies Required: 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end. Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface. Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team. Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter. Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually. Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is. Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations. Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material. Preferred / Nice to Have: Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it. Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform. Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers. Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security. Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls. Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction. Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Menlo Mindsets The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success. Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same. What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go. Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same. What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises. United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes. Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development. Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value. What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. title: Technical Trainer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Client Education team Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from. The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace. We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land. What you'll be doing Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling. Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs. Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform. Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one. Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard. Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging. What you'll need to have done Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from. Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience. Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background. Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure. Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you. Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief. You're unlikely to thrive here if You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you. You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level. You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Our commitment to Diversity hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <p>As the Senior Product Manager<strong>, </strong>you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.</p> <ul> <li>Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs</li> <li>Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences</li> <li>Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation,
